summary: Fixed a live reopen-after-broker-stop race in S007: decide() could still want a label the broker had already stopped out (its own M1-bar plan lagged the real tick-based fill by one cycle) and would attempt to re-place it with a now-invalid stop, saved only by luck when the broker rejected the order (TRADING_BAD_STOPS). Added StrategyLogger.label_was_opened() and made decide() backfill the close (reason=broker_side_close_detected) the same cycle it notices a previously-opened label missing from broker positions, instead of waiting for the next cycle to notice. Added regression tests covering both the new label_was_opened() method and the end-to-end decide() path.

Surfaced S007 "ghost" trades: plan_now() now returns reached_tp/n_recovery in context and a new resolved list of positions the engine entered AND resolved (stop/tp/daycap) within the same replayed bars -- these never reach the broker because decide() only places orders for still-open ('eod') positions, so previously they left no trace at all. decide() now logs each first-seen resolved position via a new StrategyLogger.label_was_ghosted()-guarded position(label, "ghost", ...) call. Investigated live 2026-08-05: a B setup formed and resolved before any cycle saw it as open; a historical replay of the events log (2026-08-01 through 2026-08-05) found 2 prior days (08-01, 08-03) with the same pattern -- a scenario detected, n_desired never above 0, no order ever placed -- newly distinguishable from a normal no-signal day now that this is logged.
